assumptions: Binary hidden mapping flips independently at each cycle.
Two ports have conditionally independent real arrivals.
All paired events are completely and legally observed in this calculation.
Known model parameters; uniform initial belief; current cue is given.

information_scope.paired_filter: Both port outcomes may be combined; this is an additional information/integration reference if the learned local updater cannot combine ports.
information_scope.matched_local_filter: The direct local baseline must update only from the same cell/port lawful receipts as the candidate, retain cue and age, and use the same material transport interface.
information_scope.local_negative_control: For one binary port with p=.8/.2, likelihood ratio is 4, not 16. h=.08 does NOT force last-only optimality for that local information set. h=.25 gives prior odds bound 3, so each actually observed single-port outcome overrides the predicted prior; gaps with missing observations need their actual elapsed time.
information_scope.event_multiplicity: One port event exposed to 49 cells is one correlated event, not 49 independent Bernoulli observations.

interpretation: The first regime leaves information that the latest informative pair alone discards; it is therefore a defensible task for testing accumulated evidence.
The second paired-information regime is an explicit counterexample: a sophisticated predictor cannot improve the optimal side over the latest informative pair under these assumptions.
Neither prediction advantage establishes improved uptake, net energy, viable morphology, learned update-rule novelty, or optimal bodily control.
The two example histories share the latest observation, not an empirically matched physical body or maturation pipeline. Any bodily content intervention must match the full actual checkpoint.
No outcomes were flipped or re-labelled; physical experiments must generate real stochastic supply and use the original completion receipts.
